name: Saturn USDat
oneLiner: USDat is Saturn's non-yield-bearing M0-backed dollar token, mintable and redeemable through KYC-gated Swap Facility flows.
collateral: 100% backed by M (M0 Protocol's tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bills) at launch — capital is held directly in the USDat smart contract and verifiable on-chain; protocol roadmap allows reserves to shift toward digital credit instruments (e.g. Strategy STRC preferred equity) over time
pegMechanism: Permissioned 1:1 mint by depositing USDC via the M0 Swap Facility (Uniswap V3 1bps tier) which routes through wM; redemption returns USDC by unwrapping USDat back to wM and burning the USDat. Only KYC-onboarded addresses can mint, redeem, or hold USDat; geofenced away from US, EEA, and OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions

proofOfReserves.provider: Saturn Protocol reserve analytics API (in-house, live same-day JSON of USDC/M/USDAT composition dominated by M0's $M; the previously recorded Accountable + Chainlink attribution is unsubstantiated - CSP and bundles show only the M0 stack and Chainlink CCIP messaging, no PoR vendor)

suspended.reason: M0 Protocol API moved to keyed access (HTTP 500 on the public GraphQL endpoint since 2026-08-19); no API key issued yet
